profile_text.body:
CACI International Inc. is a public company traded on the NYSE under the ticker CACI, founded in 1962 and headquartered in Arlington County. Its site describes work in national security and government technology, including electronic warfare, counter-UAS, deep learning, and DevSecOps solutions, and it announced the opening of the CACI Manufacturing Center of Excellence for Defense Electronics in the Greater Rochester, New York, area. The company also describes a philanthropy program called Good Dogs for Great Americans and states it has received a one-year plus four option periods award to support U.S. Central Command (USCENTCOM) and its mission partners.

According to its site, CACI's technology work spans RF-based solutions, drawing on more than 20 years of experience in that area, with modular, scalable, software-defined systems it describes as battle-proven, rapidly deployable, and interoperable with existing C-UxS systems. It also describes modernizing end-to-end IT infrastructure from on-premises to cloud and edge, modernizing government applications and business processes using Agile methodologies and advanced analytics, and American-made optical communication, sensing, and processing technology. The site states CACI was selected to deliver technology for the U.S. Space Force.

The company's SEC filing record lists CIK 0000016058. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for CACI in the available material.
